changes.name: Kartitsa Gold Deposit
changes.method: Underground resource model (concept; future mine plan/FID not approved)
changes.previous: 2026-03-10 maiden JORC Inferred Resource: 2.49 Mt @ 1.55 g/t Au, 123.8 koz contained gold. March estimate had OP and UG portions.
changes.current: 2026-11-20 updated JORC Inferred Resource: 2.45 Mt @ 1.96 g/t Au, 154.0 koz gold (~+25% contained ounces); all resource now classified in an optimized underground stope envelope; no current OP resource reported. NOT Mineral Reserves.
changes.output: No production; potential processing at existing Pampalo plant, subject to studies
changes.resource: JORC 2012 Inferred 2.45 Mt @ 1.96 g/t Au (154 koz); NOT reserves, not yet economic viability proven
changes.life: Mine life not established; 154 koz not equivalent to 8 years of approved Kartitsa mine life
changes.nextstep: Detailed pathway-to-production evaluation early 2027; indicative development after Southern Gold Line start ~2030, potentially 2033-34, not FID or confirmed mine startup. Coordinates unverified: do not create/update lat/lng.
changes.equipment_impact: No near-term fleet order evidenced. Potential underground drilling/development equipment and Pampalo shared processing after studies; monitor resource upgrades, PEA/PFS, financing and FID; milestone around 2033-34 is aspirational.
